🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: defensives like JNJ (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +9.16%) ABOVE TREND are holding up and both Financials (-0.52% 1W) and Industrials (-1.07% 1W) are negative, supporting the RISK-OFF call; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +20.73%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.55% | 1M: +20.92%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +14.59%) ABOVE TREND. Communication next: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength (PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND) but mixed.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Consumer Staples also under pressure with CRH (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND and EL (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.44% | 1M: -3.26%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +10.18% | 1M: -11.80%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -4.24%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in semi/tech capital goods and cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +25.19%), INTU (1W: +20.81%), PLTR (1W: +14.27%). Major divergence present (multiple large 1W gains but negative 1M for INTU/NOW/PANW and others) — tactical moves, watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/CORRECTION risk: Tech 1W: +1.05% | 1M: -7.34% (24 stocks) with big dispersion; NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -10.18%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND — breadth mixed, watch leadership concentration.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft/at risk: Financials 1W: -0.52% | 1M: -4.57% with JPM (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -1.84%) RECOVERY but the sector remains negative; no broad financial leadership to offset risk.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively defensive: Healthcare 1W: +0.05% | 1M: +2.81% with JNJ (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +9.16%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND, supporting the defensive bid under RISK-OFF.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and selective defensive healthcare exposure (XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to high-multiple semiconductors and parts of tech showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, AMD, LRCX); style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a RISK-OFF framework.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through, VLO (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +20.73%) ABOVE TREND on energy strength. BEARISH: LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND for further downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +13.05%) — concentration of ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Materials (1W weakness) — watch NKE and CRH for follow-through.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure below recent support as sign of extended downside; NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND — watch for pullback/volume to confirm sustainable breakout; XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND — hold/monitor on energy momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CRH (+60): CRH (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND — positive news but price falling; divergence suggests distribution or slow info flow. (Limited overlap between bullish news list and available price data.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-50): LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment confirmed by price. F (-50): F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. MSFT (-45): MSFT (1W: +3.84% | 1M: -5.91%) RECOVERY — negative headlines but short-term strength, watch for divergence.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Value/Cyclical tilt. XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND and NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND are at risk. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and major 1W/1M divergences (INTU/NOW/PANW and several megacaps) — monitor sentiment-price divergences closely.
